name: Fossefall
starters: Introduce Fossefall to infrastructure investors who are meeting us for the first time: who we are, what we are building and where the company is heading.
A short overview of the platform strategy for people joining the team, from infrastructure builder to full-stack compute platform.
A brand introduction for agencies and partners working with Fossefall: what the identity stands for and how to use it.

forest.label: Deep forest (primary colours)
forest.source: Brand guideline p.9, sampled from the drawn swatches

images.alt: A walker and a dog seen from behind between tall pine trunks at a lake shore
images.use: Human scale, calm, long-term thinking. Good for introductions, people and values slides.

images.alt: A tall waterfall dropping down a dark rock face with a hiker standing beside it
images.use: The brand's defining image: the vertical drop, power, flow. Good for energy, power and scale slides. Portrait: use in split layouts, not full-bleed.
Texture and detail. Good as a quiet supporting image for sustainability or precision topics.

images.alt: Aerial view of pine forest meeting a sandy shoreline and shallow water
images.use: Overview and structure. Used behind the contents slide in the template. Low resolution: keep it under a dark overlay or at half width.

images.alt: Mist drifting across a granite mountainside above autumn forest
images.use: Atmosphere, scale, the Norwegian landscape. Portrait: use in split or gallery layouts.

images.alt: Low cloud over a still fjord between forested hills
images.use: Wide hero image. Good for full-bleed photo title slides.
